headline: iFixit's look inside the iPhone Duo may explain those broken screens and hinges
summary: iFixit tore down the new iPhone Duo. Found details on Apple's folding screen crease design. Gave it a 5/10 repairability score, highest for the Duo.

headline: Scott Walker's The Drift will get under your skin
summary: Review of Scott Walker's 2006 album, "The Drift." Described as genuinely terrifying and upsetting music. Explores unsettling themes, perfect for "Spooky Season."

headline: A YouTuber dissected an iPhone Duo and thinks he found the cause of crackgate
summary: YouTuber dissected an iPhone Duo following widespread "crackgate" reports. Users report hinges failing and screens cracking quickly. Investigation points to a potential cause for the foldable's breakage.

headline: Zen Browser is the Arc replacement I was looking for
summary: Zen Browser emerges as a potential replacement for Arc. Arc was admired for its innovative browser design. Atlassian's acquisition of Arc led to a focus on Dia, an AI browser.

headline: Mass Effect's Commander Shepard Actors, Destiny Community Help #SaveMassEffect Petition Cross 200,000 Signatures
summary: #SaveMassEffect petition reaches over 200,000 signatures. Commander Shepard voice actors support the movement. The Destiny community also boosted the petition's reach.

headline: Phantom Blade Zero Review
summary: Review for the new game, Phantom Blade Zero. Features memorable boss fights and compelling combat. Praised for its limitless swagger and style.

headline: X-Men Actor Christopher Abbott Insists His Professor X Is Not in Doomsday or Secret Wars
summary: Christopher Abbott (Professor X) clarifies future Marvel appearances. States he will not be in Avengers: Doomsday or Secret Wars. Needs to conclude X-Men commitments before other cameos.

headline: Clayface Looks Like a Win for the DCU After Earning $43 Million in Box Office Opening Weekend
summary: "Clayface" proves a box office success for the DCU. Secured the top spot globally on its opening weekend. Earned an impressive $43 million in initial sales.

headline: Lula wins but faces hostile Congress and divided country
summary: President Lula secures a surprising election victory. Faces immediate challenges from a hostile Congress. The country remains deeply polarized after the election.

headline: Two men killed by falling trees as Storm Boelo leaves 90,000 properties without power
summary: Storm Boelo caused two fatalities from falling trees. 90,000 properties are left without power across the UK. Amber wind warning has now expired after severe weather.

headline: Elation across Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić concedes to student-led protest movement
summary: Serbian ruler Vučić concedes power after 12 years. Concession follows a powerful student-led protest movement. Election loss signals a major shift for the country's future.

headline: Healey's Budget needs to sustain the stronger economy through gathering clouds
summary: Healey's Budget aims to maintain a strong economy. Current economic outlook is positive. Potential challenges loom for the Labour government by January.
